_note: Week of August 31-September 6, 2026 — a full cuisine switch from last week's soy-ginger-sesame run to Mediterranean/Greek: lemon, garlic, oregano, olive oil, feta, tomatoes. The tzatziki slot is literally tzatziki this time. Monday's lemon-oregano chicken thighs carry into Tuesday's gyro pitas (the standing Pita Tuesday leftover-plus-treat structure, just pita bread now instead of lettuce cups). Wednesday and Friday are fish nights, Saturday is vegetarian stuffed peppers, and Sunday's breakfast-for-dinner is shakshuka. No mushrooms, lentils, okra, eggplant, or farro; onion cooked in, not raw. Jake's lunch stays saucy and reheat-friendly with broccoli, no olives (don't hold up over 5 days). Laine's lunch is the standing tuna jar, unchanged.

tzatziki.name: Tzatziki
tzatziki.note: Actual tzatziki this week — Greek yogurt, cucumber, garlic, lemon, olive oil, and dill. Goes on Tuesday's gyro pitas. Makes about 1.5 cups (6 servings of ¼ cup), keeps 4-5 days refrigerated.

ingredients.item: English cucumber — 100g, grated and squeezed dry

steps: Grate the cucumber, then squeeze out as much liquid as possible in a clean towel.
Combine yogurt, cucumber, garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, and dill in a bowl.
Season with salt, stir to combine.
Refrigerate at least 30 min before serving to let the flavors meld.

dinners.name: Lemon-Oregano Greek Chicken Thighs with Roasted Potatoes & Zucchini
dinners.note: Not a fish night. Cook extra chicken alongside for Tuesday.

ingredients.item: Chicken thighs, boneless skinless — Jake 300g, Laine 190g raw (buy ~220g extra for Tuesday)
Olive oil — Jake 1½ tbsp, Laine 1 tbsp
Lemon juice — Jake 1 tbsp, Laine ¾ tbsp
Oregano/thyme/cumin/paprika/salt spice mix — Jake 1 tsp, Laine ¾ tsp

steps: Toss cubed potatoes with olive oil, salt, and half the spice mix. Roast at 425°F 20 min.
Whisk lemon juice, garlic, remaining olive oil, and remaining spice mix. Toss the chicken thighs (Monday's portion plus Tuesday's reserved piece) in the marinade.
Push potatoes aside, add chicken and zucchini to the sheet pan. Roast another 18-20 min until chicken hits 165°F.
Set Tuesday's reserved chicken portion aside once cooked, before slicing Monday's servings.

dinners.name: Chicken & Shrimp Gyro Pitas with Tzatziki
dinners.note: Leftover Monday chicken plus a shrimp treat, in pita instead of lettuce cups this week.

ingredients.item: Reserved chicken thigh from Monday — Jake 150g, Laine 100g, sliced
Frozen shrimp — Jake 120g, Laine 80g raw, peeled
Yellow onion — Jake ⅛ cup, Laine scant ⅛ cup, diced and cooked
Olive oil — Jake ½ tbsp, Laine scant ½ tbsp
Tzatziki — Jake ~2 servings, Laine ~1½ servings (see recipe card)

steps: Sauté the onion in olive oil until soft.
Add shrimp, cook 2-3 min until opaque. Add the sliced chicken, warm through.
Warm the pitas. Fill with the chicken-shrimp mixture, cucumber, and tomatoes.
Top generously with tzatziki.

dinners.name: Mediterranean Baked Salmon with Cherry Tomatoes, Olives & Rice

ingredients.item: Olive oil — Jake 1 tbsp, Laine ¾ tbsp
Lemon juice — Jake 1 tbsp, Laine ¾ tbsp
Oregano/thyme/cumin/paprika/salt spice mix — Jake ½ tsp, Laine scant ½ tsp

steps: Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, and spice mix. Place salmon on a lined sheet pan, spoon the mixture over.
Scatter cherry tomatoes and olives around the salmon.
Bake at 400°F 12-15 min until the salmon flakes easily.
Cook the rice. Jake gets the bigger fillet.

dinners.name: Greek-Spiced Turkey & White Bean Skillet
dinners.note: Free night — lean ground turkey for variety from the chicken thighs earlier in the week.

ingredients.item: Cannellini beans — Jake ½ can, Laine scant ⅓ can, rinsed
Olive oil — Jake 1 tbsp, Laine ¾ tbsp
Yellow onion — Jake ⅓ cup, Laine ¼ cup, diced and cooked
Oregano/thyme/cumin/paprika/salt spice mix — Jake 1 tsp, Laine ¾ tsp

steps: Cook the rice.
Brown the turkey in olive oil with onion and garlic, breaking it up as it cooks.
Add cannellini beans, cherry tomatoes, and spice mix, simmer 5 min.
Stir in spinach at the end until just wilted. Serve over rice.

dinners.name: Lemon-Garlic Shrimp & Cod with Spinach and Rice

ingredients.item: Frozen shrimp — Jake 120g, Laine 80g raw, peeled
Frozen cod — Jake 140g, Laine 95g raw, cubed
Olive oil — Jake 1 tbsp, Laine ¾ tbsp
Lemon juice — Jake 1 tbsp, Laine ¾ tbsp
Oregano/thyme/cumin/paprika/salt spice mix — Jake ½ tsp, Laine scant ½ tsp

steps: Cook the rice.
Sauté the cod and shrimp in olive oil with garlic until just opaque, remove.
Add spinach to the pan, wilt 1-2 min.
Return the seafood, add lemon juice and spice mix, toss gently. Serve over rice.

dinners.name: Mediterranean Stuffed Peppers

ingredients.item: Bell pepper — Jake 2 large (halved, seeded), Laine 1½ large
Garbanzo beans — Jake scant ½ can, Laine ⅓ can, rinsed
Diced tomatoes, canned — Jake ⅓ cup, Laine scant ⅓ cup
Feta cheese, reduced fat — Jake 60g, Laine 45g, crumbled
Olive oil — Jake 1 tbsp, Laine ¾ tbsp
Yellow onion — Jake ⅓ cup, Laine ¼ cup, diced and cooked
Oregano/thyme/cumin/paprika/salt spice mix — Jake 1 tsp, Laine ¾ tsp

steps: Cook the quinoa. Halve and seed the bell peppers, roast cut-side up at 400°F 10 min to soften.
Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil, add diced tomatoes and spice mix, simmer 3-4 min.
Stir in the cooked quinoa and garbanzo beans.
Fill the pepper halves with the mixture, top with feta, and bake another 10-12 min until the peppers are tender.

dinners.name: Shakshuka with Feta & Crusty Bread
dinners.note: Breakfast-for-dinner — eggs poached in a spiced tomato sauce.

ingredients.item: Diced tomatoes, canned — Jake 1½ cups, Laine scant 1¼ cups
Yellow onion — Jake ¼ cup, Laine scant ¼ cup, diced and cooked
Feta cheese, reduced fat — Jake 25g, Laine 20g, crumbled
Olive oil — Jake 1 tbsp, Laine ¾ tbsp
Oregano/thyme/cumin/paprika/salt spice mix — Jake 1 tsp, Laine ¾ tsp
Whole grain bread — Jake 2 slices, Laine 1½ slices

steps: Sauté onion and bell pepper in olive oil until soft. Add garlic, cook 1 min.
Add diced tomatoes and spice mix, simmer 8-10 min until slightly thickened.
Make wells in the sauce, crack in the eggs. Cover and cook 6-8 min until whites are set.
Top with crumbled feta. Serve with toasted bread for scooping.

jakeLunch.name: Greek Lemon-Garlic Chicken Thigh & Quinoa Bowl
jakeLunch.note: Sunday-batch, 5 containers, no fish. Same reheat-friendly format, Mediterranean this time — chicken thighs marinated in lemon, garlic, and oregano instead of a soy-based sauce. Broccoli, not spinach. No olives (don't hold up over 5 days of reheating).

ingredients.item: Chicken thighs, boneless skinless — ~3.3 lbs total (300g raw per container)
Olive oil — scant 1 tbsp per container
Oregano/thyme/cumin/paprika/salt spice mix — 1 tsp per container

steps: Cook all the quinoa at once.
Whisk lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, and spice mix into a marinade. Toss the cubed chicken thighs in it.
Sear the chicken in a hot pan until browned and cooked through.
Add broccoli and bell pepper to the pan, stir-fry 4-5 min until just tender.
Divide quinoa and the chicken-vegetable mixture evenly across 5 containers.

laineLunch.name: Cold Tuna & Black Bean Mason Jar
laineLunch.dressingNote: Olive oil + lemon juice, kept separate and added just before eating.

ingredients.item: Canned tuna in water — 1 can per jar (5 cans total)
Black beans — ~¼ can per jar, rinsed
Avocado — ½ avocado per jar, added fresh when eating
Olive oil — 1 tbsp per jar (dressing, separate)
Lemon juice — scant ½ tbsp per jar

steps: Drain tuna, rinse black beans. Dice cucumber and bell pepper.
Layer each jar: black beans → tuna → cucumber → bell pepper.
Portion the dressing into a small separate container per jar.
To eat: add dressing and fresh-cut avocado, stir, eat straight from the jar.

laineBreakfasts.name: Greek Yogurt Parfait
steps: Spoon yogurt into a bowl. Top with thawed berries and flaxseed.

laineBreakfasts.name: Spinach & Feta Egg White Scramble
laineBreakfasts.note: Kept as-is — same-day cooked, so it doesn't have the reheating issue lunch spinach had.

ingredients.item: Pinch oregano, thyme, cumin, paprika, salt

steps: Sauté cherry tomatoes 1-2 min in a dry nonstick pan until they start to soften.
Add egg whites, scramble over medium-low until just set.
Toss in spinach at the end. Top with feta and a pinch of spice mix.

laineBreakfasts.name: Birch Benders Waffles + Berries
laineBreakfasts.note: Standing Sunday-morning waffles, separate from Sunday's breakfast-for-dinner — unchanged.

ingredients.item: Birch Benders pancake/waffle mix — ½ cup dry

steps: Mix batter: mix + egg whites + water per package. Stir in flaxseed.
Cook in a preheated waffle iron 3-4 min until crisp.
Top with thawed berries.

laineSnacks.name: Cucumber + Hummus
laineSnacks.desc: ¾ cucumber sliced + hummus for dipping.

laineSnacks.name: Greek Yogurt + Berries
laineSnacks.desc: 1 Oikos Triple Zero + small handful thawed berries.

jakeSnacks.name: Cottage Cheese + Tart Cherries
jakeSnacks.desc: 1 cup cottage cheese + 1 cup frozen tart cherries, thawed — the uric-acid-friendly swap, kept in.

jakeSnacks.name: Roasted Chickpeas + Almonds
jakeSnacks.desc: ¼ cup roasted chickpeas + a small handful of almonds.

jakeSnacks.name: Greek Yogurt + Almonds
jakeSnacks.desc: 1 container plain Greek yogurt + a small handful of almonds.

Must Buy: Chicken thighs, boneless skinless — ~4.7 lbs (Monday + Tuesday leftovers + Jake's lunch batch)
Bell peppers — ~4-5 large (Saturday stuffed peppers, Sunday shakshuka, Jake's lunch, Laine's lunch)
Cherry tomatoes — 1 pint (Wednesday, Thursday, Friday's breakfast scramble)
Yellow onion — 1 large (Tuesday, Thursday, Saturday, Sunday)
Feta cheese, reduced fat — restock, used across Saturday, Sunday, and the breakfast scramble
Whole grain bread — if low, needed for Sunday
Canned tuna in water — 5 cans (Laine's lunch)
Check Supply: Olive oil — used in nearly every dish this week, likely needs a fresh bottle
Lemon juice — used across Monday, Wednesday, Friday, tzatziki, Jake's lunch, and Laine's lunch — probably needs a fresh bottle or a few lemons
Garlic — used in almost everything, make sure you have a full bulb
White rice (dry) — ~0.45 lb needed (Wednesday, Thursday, Friday)
Oregano/thyme/cumin/paprika/salt spice blend — used across most of the week, check the jar
Broccoli florets — Jake's lunch only this week
Greek yogurt (plain nonfat), Oikos Triple Zero — breakfasts, snacks, and tzatziki
Baby spinach — Thursday, Friday, and the breakfast scramble
Frozen mixed berries, ground flaxseed — breakfast + snack staples
Hummus, roasted chickpeas, almonds, almond butter, cottage cheese, apples, bananas, frozen tart cherries — snack staples
Birch Benders mix — Sunday morning waffles
